title: Evil House
content: Does anyone else have occasional dreams/nightmares where you live in a large old house, kind of boarding house vibes because several people (sometimes friends/acquaintances from irl, sometimes family or nonexistent people) live there with you in separate rooms. It always has negative energy even if the dream isn’t a nightmare, but it isn’t necessarily haunted. Just dark vibes. Mine is always drab and dusty with wood-paneled walls and floors and a wooden exterior as well. I generated some images that remind me of it, but it’s not exact. Do you have something similar in any way?
